title: Two-year old Oracle WebLogic Server vulnerability is being exploited

title: Russian hackers exploit WinRAR vulnerability for data theft
summary: The exploitation chain begins with a weaponized HTML Application payload called GammaPhish, which retrieves intermediate Visual Basic Script (VBScript) downloaders known as GammaLoad, according to Sekoia.
